title: TractionCurrentMeasurementUncertaintyBudgetV2
description: Rigorous GUM (JCGM 100:2008) and ISO 14253-1:2017 compliant measurement uncertainty budget recalculating combined and expanded uncertainty from first principles, correcting prior arithmetic errors.

standards_references.application: Evaluation of measurement data — Guide to the expression of uncertainty in measurement
Assessment of higher-order Taylor expansion terms for sliding RMS square-root transformation
Binary statement of conformity with guard band g = U
Binary decision rule with guard banding for high-consequence safety verification

measurement_model.equation: I_RMS = sqrt( (1/N) * sum_{j=0}^{N-1} ( (V_j - V_offset - delta_V_temp)/(S_probe * K_filter) + eps_noise + eps_quant )^2 ) + eps_RMS_num
measurement_model.nonlinearity_assessment_jcgm_amd1: Evaluated around I_RMS = 0.500 A (y = I^2 = 0.250 A^2). Second-order Taylor series curvature term d2(sqrt(y))/dy2 contributes delta_u < 0.0008 A (< 1.8% of u_c). Linear GUM sensitivity coefficients remain valid without requiring Monte Carlo integration.

prior_budget_audit_findings.root_cause: The prior report published u_c = 0.0436 A, U = 0.087 A, and threshold = 0.413 A. However, the root-sum-square of the seven listed standard uncertainties in that very report is sqrt(0.015^2 + 0.020^2 + 0.025^2 + 0.010^2 + 0.018^2 + 0.012^2 + 0.015^2) = 0.04520 A. The prior numbers were mathematically inconsistent with the reported component values.

recalculated_uncertainty_components.source: Tektronix TCP303 / TCPA300 factory gain calibration and 50-ohm termination tolerance
Residual Hall-effect DC zero offset drift post-degaussing and front-panel balance nulling
Inverter DC link switching ripple leakage and bench optical/inductive quiescent noise floor
Keysight DSOX1204G 8-bit vertical resolution (100 mV/div vertical scale, 3.125 mV LSB)
Sliding RMS rectangular window finite discrete sum integration (N = 2000 samples, 1 MSa/s)
Hall element temperature sensitivity over operating ambient range (15 deg C to 48 deg C)
DSO 20 kHz hardware low-pass filter passband ripple and transient group delay dispersion

budget_synthesis.audit_reconciliation_verdict: The mathematically sound guarded threshold is 0.410 A RMS (0.4096 A RMS), NOT the legacy 0.413 A RMS.
